messages.subject: Clean Energy Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Green Recruit Team,

Your executive-search work across clean energy and renewable-sector leadership is relevant to my background at the intersection of resources, sustainability and institutional engagement. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where clean-energy growth requires credible regulatory, government and stakeholder relationships. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
